_comment: WHAT THE BASEMAP HAS FOR TEN OF THE FORTY-FOUR. Complete, 11 September 2026.
ONE HIT IN TEN. Only Hynovi's host works — 'cimenterie Vicat' — is drawn and named, and
it qualifies under the rule that a site may be placed on the works it stands on. The
other nine have plenty drawn nearby and none of it is the plant: substations, scrap
yards, bus depots, street cabinets labelled Substation, and between 2 and 195 unnamed
industrial parcels each. THE BASEMAP IS NOT EMPTY AT THESE PLACES; IT IS FULL OF THE
WRONG THINGS.
THE SWEEP INHERITS THE BENCHMARK'S ERROR, and that is the second finding. The radius is
centred on the benchmark's coordinate because that is the only hint available before a
position exists — and at Eemshaven and Falkenhagen that coordinate is 25 km and 150 km
from where the owner says the plant is. Two of the ten sweeps looked in the wrong place
and could only ever have returned nothing. A sweep should be centred on the OWNER'S
named place wherever the owner names one, which is a change to how the remaining
thirty-four are run.
MACHINE BUCKET AND HAND VERDICT ARE BOTH RECORDED AND THEY DISAGREE. `machine_bucket` is
what the tool's tag test proposed; `hand_verdict` is what a person concluded after
reading the names. Nine of ten came back `works` from the machine and one from the
person. A bucket is a discovery aid; it is not a finding.
RUN LOCALLY AGAINST DATED GEOFABRIK EXTRACTS, NOT A PUBLIC ENDPOINT. The first attempt
lost eight of ten to Overpass timeouts. These ten are repeatable: the extract name, its
date and its SHA-256 are below, and sources/osm/sweep.py refuses a file whose date it
cannot read.
method: sources/osm/sweep.py against Geofabrik extracts read locally

results.hand_note: The only named feature inside 5 km is a solar park. AND THE SWEEP WAS AIMED WRONG: the hint is the benchmark's coordinate at Pieterburen, 25 km from the Eems power plant site the owner names. This is a site disagreement reaching into the basemap work.

Five substations, a flow-measurement institute and 195 unnamed industrial parcels. The Enecogen power station the owner names as the neighbour is not among the named features returned, so not even the host works can be reached from here.

The Drushba pipeline and a row of storage tanks at Schwedt. AIMED WRONG for the same reason as Eemshaven: the benchmark's coordinate is Schwedt/Oder and ENERTRAG's own release puts the plant at the Gewerbepark Prignitz-Falkenhagen, 150 km west.
One named feature in 3 km, the port at Vierow, and two unnamed parcels. The decommissioned nuclear station site the owner names is not drawn as anything named.
A scrap metal yard, an industrial service company and a long list of street substations, plus 65 unnamed parcels. NPorts' four hectares are not named.

Vicat's own release puts the 330 MW electrolyser at 'the cement plant in Montalieu-Vercieu', and the host-works rule already admits a site placed on the works it stands on. THE ONE HIT IN TEN, and the reason the bucket rule had to be corrected: the first version sent every landuse=industrial feature to `estate` and buried it.

A bus depot and a substation, three unnamed parcels. The Los Barrios coal-fired station whose site EDP is reusing is not drawn under a name.
